actions.action: Push a finger 2-3 inches into the soil to check dryness
Lift the inner pot out of the decorative pot, empty standing water and check the bottom of the inner pot
Check whether roots are circling or pushing out of the drainage holes (root-bound)
Water thoroughly until it drains, then let the top 2-3 inches dry before the next watering
Use filtered or rain water if tap water is hard
Move the plant slightly out of direct midday sun
Alternatively, hang a sheer curtain to diffuse the light
Inspect leaf undersides and leaf joints for mealybugs
Dab any mealybugs with rubbing alcohol on a cotton swab
Repot into a pot with drainage if roots are crowded

reason: The answer gives underwatering as one of two equal possibilities alongside water trapped in the outer pot, and puts the thorough-watering fix among several other steps, but nothing it recommends would harm the plant.
